cases.name: roundtrip

expect.stdout:
hello world
hello world
hello world

exec_argv: import subprocess,sys; bb=sys.argv[1]; ap=sys.argv[2]; opts=sys.argv[3:]; d=b'hello world\n'*3; c=subprocess.run([bb,ap,'-c']+opts,input=d,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,check=True).stdout; sys.stdout.buffer.write(subprocess.run([bb,ap,'-d','-c'],input=c,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,check=True).stdout)
